svg.text: The life of one block: unit 10
The frames of one request (A) arriving and leaving, seen from a single unit. Same replay of Arena and Engine as the frames.
The same unit becomes the cache's while A still holds it: two refcounts, no copy. A never writes it again: the page is full.
A is gone, the cache keeps it: cache-only, valid K/V, and the next request with this prompt can ref it.
Evicted while step 43 is in flight: pending records the last committed step, not the last reader.
Back to free only when the event passes 43. alloc takes the lowest free bit, so it is reused at once.
